mandatory_holds.trigger: Required authority, handling approval, usable baseline or critical prospective limit absent
mandatory_holds.response: Do not activate affected comparison; continue authorized ordinary service.

mandatory_holds.trigger: Unauthorized mandate/output reduction or loss of required critical capability
mandatory_holds.response: Stop experimental change through authorized owner; preserve required service through approved fallback.

mandatory_holds.trigger: Plausible serious safety impact or critical readiness/quality failure
mandatory_holds.response: Protect operations promptly, preserve observations and refer for competent incident review; do not infer causation automatically.

mandatory_holds.trigger: Threatened mandatory deadline, unmeasured transferred work or material evidence-integrity failure
mandatory_holds.response: Hold affected comparison, preserve full denominator and incurred cost, and document unresolved claims.

mandatory_holds.trigger: Sensitive record handling or disclosure outside approved authority
mandatory_holds.response: Stop affected collection/publication; follow approved local incident and evidence-preservation procedure.

restart: Competent approval and resolution of trigger required; no retroactive tolerance changes or automatic restart.
